sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 800. Success value 100. 5x magic damage (Fire).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Applies Field Obstacle to the enemy Field.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Frail for 40 seconds with a success value of 150.
-Target: all allies. Applies dual attack, reducing the cooldown time of the next Ability used to 0 (except for certain Abilities).
-Target: all allies. Increases Cost recovery speed by 10 for 150 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases Unison gauge gains by 2 for 150 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Armament for 150 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; increases ATK and MATK by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
-Applies United Tactics (increases all stats by 150%, increases max Unison gauge capacity by 30, nullifies Unison gauge reduction, increases Unison gauge gains by 1) to the allied Field for 120 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 50000

[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Applies Grace for 150 seconds (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction, status ailments, and debuffs. After the effect ends, 100 Cost is restored to your character).

[Aqours] Kanan Matsuura or Ninoyu with the same or higher Cost of the base Monster can be used as fodder.
 *Specific Monsters may also be used. See the Help section for details.
